_comment: TUNABLE ALLOWLIST of content-owner team slugs to @-mention on error-severity tutorial-ci findings. This is the single knob maintainers edit to control who gets pinged when a content check fails. JSON has no native comments, so this documentation lives in the reserved `_comment*` keys (ignored by consumers, which read only `teamSlugAllowlist`).
_comment_globs: Each entry is matched against a team slug as a GLOB: `*` matches any run of characters, everything else is literal. e.g. `devrelations-*` matches BOTH `devrelations-contribution` and `devrelations-production`. Only teams whose slug matches at least one pattern are mentioned — this keeps a tutorial content-check failure from paging security/monitoring/admin teams that also happen to have repo access (e.g. securityalerts, monitor, admins, admin-write).
_comment_empty: An EMPTY or MISSING `teamSlugAllowlist` mentions NO ONE (fail-safe: an unconfigured allowlist most naturally means 'no content owners are configured'). See scripts/normalize-findings.js buildTeamMentions().
